title: Managed IT Services | Purview Services
description: Managed services from delivery centres in the UK, Poland, Singapore, Australia and India, with SLAs we sign against and a 24×7 NOC behind them.
h1: Run, support and secure what you already have
lede: Managed services from delivery centres in the UK, Poland, Singapore, Australia and India, with SLAs we sign against and a 24×7 NOC behind them.

blocks.text: Always-on operations. Built around your estate.
Service teams, monitoring, engineering and governance working together across business-critical environments.
Critical infrastructure needs people, processes and observability around the clock. Explore how Purview supports the estates that enterprises depend on.

items.title: Help Desk Services
items.body: Multilingual L1 and L2 service desk, ITIL-aligned, with self-service and AI-assisted triage that cuts ticket volume rather than just answering it faster.

items.title: Infrastructure Managed Services
items.body: Hybrid estate operations: servers, storage, networks and cloud under one NOC, with observability tooling and capacity planning built in.

items.title: Managed Application Services
items.body: Application support and enhancement for enterprise platforms including SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Pega and custom estates.

items.title: Managed IT Support
items.body: End-user computing, device lifecycle, field support and white-glove installation for offices, labs and towers.

items.title: Managed Security Services
items.body: SOC as a service, SIEM, vulnerability management and incident response, now extended to AI and LLM estates.

items.title: Managed Software Development
items.body: Dedicated product teams you keep for years, run to your backlog, your tooling and your release cadence.

items.title: Managed QA Services
items.body: Test automation, performance engineering and release assurance delivered as a service with measurable coverage.

items.title: Structured Cabling & Smart Hands
items.body: Cat6A and fibre design, installation and certification, plus IMACD, rack and stack and relocation support. 24 years of cabling, now part of Purview DC.

items.title: Network Solutions (design and build)
items.body: Not a managed service in itself: the practice that surveys, designs, installs and secures a new or refreshed network. Once live, it can be run under Infrastructure Managed Services.

items.title: Managed AV Services
items.body: Three support tiers for AV and conferencing estates: remote helpdesk (4-hour response), on-site response (next business day) and fully managed with proactive monitoring, quarterly maintenance and 2-hour 24/7 response.

items.title: Data centre operations
items.body: Smart hands, L1 to L3 engineers and hyperscaler-grade operations for GPU floors, run by Purview DC.
